provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of https://snd.sssr.su/V/3.pdf, captured at 2024-09-01T23:43:07Z, before the 7 September 2026 cutoff; requested with 'Accept-Encoding: identity' (curl without --compressed) and served without Content-Encoding, so the recorded identity is the uncompressed body as replayed (a request accepting gzip may be served gzip-encoded, with different bytes). The same bytes are served as a static file by the live host (live_file_response); the capture is recorded as the identity because it is fixed before the cutoff. The original response is not checked into this repository; this checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

scope_note: The official stenographic bulletin of the Fifth Congress's morning sitting of 3 September 1991, a two-column page-image scan with an OCR layer, served by the non-official SSSR.SU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file (live_file_response). PDF pp. 1, 3 and 24 were read for the Soyuz group.

edition_and_host.edition: Внеочередной пятый Съезд народных депутатов СССР. Бюллетень № 3, 3 сентября 1991 г. (cover, PDF p. 1; running head 'Внеочередной пятый Съезд народных депутатов СССР'); 30 PDF pages, printed p. N on PDF p. N for the cited pages.
edition_and_host.host: SSSR.SU portal (snd.sssr.su, sten.vs.sssr.su): a non-commercial project registered as the media outlet 'Информационное агентство «СССР»' (Roskomnadzor ИА № ФС77-40345), not a state body and not the publisher; it serves page-image scans of the official stenographic reports as static files (see the CLAUDE-C01-SOURCE-26 review of the same host).

visual_review.method: Every cited page was rendered from the recorded bytes with PyMuPDF (100-150 dpi) and read from the page image, not from the OCR layer; the sitting headings, speaker lines and quotations were compared with the image, and the title page and imprint were read for the edition.

persons_named: Н. А. Назарбаев (Президент Казахской ССР, presiding)
rows.role_title: Сопредседатель депутатской группы «Союз» — Co-chair of the Soyuz deputies' group
rows.text: At the Fifth Congress's morning sitting of 3 September 1991 (Kremlin Palace of Congresses, 10:00, 'Председательствует Президент Казахской ССР Н. А. Назарбаев'), 'Крайко А. Н., начальник отдела отделения Центрального института авиационного моторостроения имени П. И. Баранова, г. Москва' says: 'Причем Президентом в этих условиях (знаю, такова же позиция даже лидеров группы "Союз") должен оставаться М. С. Горбачев.'
rows.locator: Bulletin No. 3: sitting heading, printed p. 3 (PDF p. 3); speech, printed p. 24 (PDF p. 24)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Co-chairs are recorded as co-leadership, one person per holder observation. State offices, the CPSU, russia.json and the simulation's party rows are outside this extract.
